programme.title: Teasing Takagi-San S3, Ep 1
programme.desc: In the Season 3 premiere, Nishikata is determined to finally outsmart Takagi during a series of playful encounters involving grip-strength training, summer tans, and the first days of the new semester. However, Takagi always seems one step ahead, turning every challenge into another opportunity to tease him. Beneath their lighthearted rivalry, both begin to show subtle signs that their relationship is becoming more meaningful, blending comedy, romance, and everyday school life.

programme.title: Teasing Takagi-San S3, Ep 1
programme.desc: Pada episode pembuka musim ketiga, Nishikata kembali berusaha mengalahkan Takagi dalam berbagai tantangan sederhana, mulai dari latihan kekuatan genggaman tangan, membandingkan kulit yang terbakar matahari, hingga momen-momen di awal semester baru. Namun, kecerdikan Takagi selalu membuat Nishikata menjadi sasaran godaan yang menghibur. Di balik persaingan yang penuh canda, keduanya perlahan menunjukkan kedekatan yang semakin berkembang, menghadirkan kisah romantis remaja yang hangat dan penuh humor.

programme.desc: A disillusioned assassin accepts one last hit in hopes of using his earnings to restore the vision of a singer he accidentally blinded.

programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh yang kecewa menerima satu serangan terakhir dengan harapan dapat menggunakan penghasilannya untuk mengembalikan penglihatan seorang penyanyi yang secara tidak sengaja dibutakannya.

programme.title: The Emperor And The Minister
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later.

programme.title: The Emperor And The Minister
programme.desc: Kaisar Qianlong bukanlah penerus takhta yang sah sejak lahir, tetapi ia baru mengetahui kebenarannya saat dua anggota senior organisasi rahasia anti-pemerintah menghubunginya beberapa tahun kemudian.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Three men who have been physically disabled by an evil warlord and his physically-disabled son become friends and learn kung fu so that they can seek revenge with help from an elderly martial-arts teacher and his mentally-disabled pupil.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Nyonya Xu melihat seorang gadis kecil bermain sendirian di pintu masuk dari jauh setiap hari. Ia dengan hangat mengasuh gadis itu, lalu mengadopsinya dari orang tuanya yang tak memedulikannya.

programme.title: That Fiery Girl
programme.desc: The bandits of Hulu Valley murder the chief of Mei Clan while searching for a treasure map.

programme.title: The Case Of Disappearances
programme.desc: When Qing Cheng was a teenager, he was attacked by an unknown mutant monster and lost his family and memory. He was regarded by the villagers as an ominous person who would bring disaster.

programme.title: The Case Of Disappearances
programme.desc: Ketika Qing Cheng masih remaja, ia diserang oleh monster mutan yang tidak dikenal dan kehilangan keluarga serta ingatannya. Ia dianggap oleh penduduk desa sebagai orang yang tidak menyenangkan yang akan membawa bencana.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Let's Have A Baby
programme.desc: A charming tale of child-creating complications, featuring a rare comedic performance by Alex Man Chi-leung.

programme.title: Let's Have A Baby
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah menarik tentang kerumitan dalam menciptakan anak, yang menampilkan penampilan komedi langka oleh Alex Man Chi Leung.

programme.title: Wusong Vs Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law's affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered. Can he avenges his brother's death?

programme.title: Wusong Vs Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song mengetahui perselingkuhan adik iparnya dengan pria kaya bernama Ximen Qing. Song pun dijebak dan diasingkan selama setahun oleh Qing, sementara sang adik dibunuh. Bisakah ia membalas kematian saudaranya?

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: As a man leaves his wife and daughter, a series of brief conversations, observed gestures, chance encounters and impulsive acts, tell the story of the relationships that flounder and thrive in the wake of this decision.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Saat seorang pria meninggalkan istri dan putrinya, serangkaian percakapan singkat, gerakan yang diamati, pertemuan tak sengaja, dan tindakan impulsif, menceritakan kisah hubungan yang gagal dan berkembang setelah keputusan ini.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A Chinese spy who's been out of service for ten years whilst making a living as a butcher is sent to Hong Kong to locate a stolen Tyrannosaurus rex skull.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: Seorang mata-mata Tiongkok yang telah pensiun selama sepuluh tahun dan mencari nafkah sebagai tukang daging dikirim ke Hong Kong untuk menemukan tengkorak Tyrannosaurus rex yang dicuri.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing created the gambling film genre almost singlehandedly, and in one of his earliest blockbusters, Shih Hsien leads a stellar cast in a tale of spies, tycoons and beautiful babes.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing menciptakan genre film perjudian hampir sendirian, dan dalam salah satu film laris awalnya, Shih Hsien memimpin pemeran bintang dalam kisah tentang mata-mata, taipan, dan gadis cantik.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Brilliant director Sun Chung and the majestic Ti Lung reunite for a thriller about an aging fighter who relives his violent past mistakes through a streetwise kid.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Sun Chung dan Ti Lung bersatu kembali untuk sebuah kisah menegangkan tentang seorang pendekar tua yang berusaha menebus kesalahannya di masa lalu melalui seorang anak jalanan yang bijaksana.

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: A judge tries to save a female innocent who's wrongly being accused for murder.

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: Seorang hakim berusaha menyelamatkan seorang wanita tak bersalah yang secara keliru dituduh melakukan pembunuhan.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. Things change, when Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man at Tamotsu's funeral.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu tewas dalam sebuah kecelakaan ski. Kemudian, teman sekamarnya, Yoshio, menikahi istrinya serta mewarisi seluruh kekayaannya. Namun, segalanya berubah sejak Yoshio bertemu seorang pria tua di pemakaman Tamotsu.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Action adventure in which the formula for a cancer-curing medicine is stolen, and a kung-fu fighting team must overcome rivals and doublecrosses in order to get it back

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Petualangan aksi di mana formula obat penyembuh kanker dicuri, dan tim petarung kung-fu harus mengatasi saingan dan pengkhianatan untuk mendapatkannya kembali.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: An actor tries to convince a lady to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series, but unbeknownst to him, she really is a witch!

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Seorang aktor berusaha meyakinkan sesosok wanita untuk berperan sebagai Samantha dalam film Bewitched yang dibuat ulang. Namun, ia tidak menyadari bila wanita itu ternyata benar-benar seorang penyihir!

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, putra dari pengusaha yang culun, mendapat kekecewaan usai mencari jodoh di Hawaii bersama temannya. Kemudian, secara tak sengaja mereka terjebak dalam sebuah pertukaran identitas yang kacau.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Never take your mistress on an annual guys' getaway, especially one devoted to hunting - a violent lesson for three wealthy married men.

programme.desc: Follow a group of children who are evacuated to a Yorkshire village during the Second World War, where they encounter a young soldier who, like them, is far away from home.

programme.title: The Railway Children Return
programme.desc: Ikuti sekelompok anak-anak yang dievakuasi ke desa Yorkshire selama Perang Dunia Kedua, di mana mereka bertemu dengan seorang prajurit muda yang, seperti mereka, jauh dari rumah.

programme.title: Animal Kingdom
programme.desc: A seventeen-year-old navigates his survival amongst an explosive criminal family and the detective who thinks he can save him.

programme.title: Badge Of Honor
programme.desc: When a drug raid ends in tragedy, veteran detectives find themselves under relentless scrutiny as an Internal Affairs investigator searches for the truth behind the fatal shooting. As hidden evidence, corruption, and conflicting loyalties begin to surface, every decision threatens to destroy careers and lives. Badge of Honor is a gritty crime thriller that explores justice, accountability, and the blurred line between duty and personal conscience.

programme.title: Badge Of Honor
programme.desc: Sebuah penggerebekan narkoba yang berakhir tragis memicu penyelidikan besar terhadap dua detektif kepolisian. Di tengah tekanan dari Internal Affairs, berbagai fakta baru mulai terungkap, mulai dari penyalahgunaan wewenang, konflik kepentingan, hingga kesetiaan yang diuji dalam institusi kepolisian. Badge of Honor menyajikan thriller kriminal penuh ketegangan yang mengangkat tema keadilan, integritas, dan konsekuensi dari setiap keputusan yang diambil dalam menjalankan tugas.

programme.title: Anything Is Possible
programme.desc: Kelsa, a bright and self-assured transgender high school senior, has learned to navigate life on her own terms despite the challenges around her. When a shy classmate develops feelings for her, the two embark on a heartfelt journey of first love, self-discovery, and acceptance. As they face family expectations, friendships, and the pressures of adolescence, they discover that honesty, courage, and compassion can overcome fear and prejudice. Anything Is Possible is an uplifting coming-of-age romance that celebrates authenticity and the power of being true to yourself.

programme.title: Anything Is Possible
programme.desc: Kelsa, siswi SMA transgender yang cerdas dan penuh percaya diri, menjalani kehidupan dengan keberanian untuk menjadi dirinya sendiri. Ketika seorang teman sekelas mulai menaruh hati padanya, keduanya menjalani kisah cinta pertama yang penuh harapan sekaligus tantangan. Di tengah dinamika keluarga, persahabatan, dan pencarian jati diri, mereka belajar bahwa kejujuran, keberanian, dan saling menghargai merupakan kunci untuk menghadapi berbagai rintangan. Anything Is Possible menghadirkan drama romantis remaja yang hangat tentang penerimaan diri, kasih sayang, dan tumbuh menjadi pribadi yang autentik.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.desc: Every time the Supa Strikas play soccer, it's always exciting! They have to compete against other teams that sometimes cheat or have secrets. Shakes and his friends have to be smart to solve mysteries and work together. Through the story of the Supa Strikas, we learn that soccer isn't just about winning, but also about good teamwork, being honest, and not giving up easily. They travel around the world, meet many new friends, and learn to be better every day.

programme.title: SUPA STRIKAS
programme.desc: Setiap kali supa strikas main bola, pasti seru sekali! mereka harus melawan tim-tim lain yang kadang curang atau punya rahasia. Shakes dan teman-temannya harus pintar memecahkan misteri dan bekerja sama. Lewat cerita supa strikas, kita jadi tahu kalau main bola itu bukan cuma tentang menang, tapi juga tentang kerja sama tim yang baik, jadi anak yang jujur, dan tidak mudah menyerah. mereka berkeliling dunia, bertemu banyak teman baru, dan belajar jadi lebih baik setiap harinya.

programme.title: Hiyokko
programme.desc: Hiyokko follows Mineko Yatabe, a cheerful young woman who grows up in a farming village in Ibaraki Prefecture during Japan's period of rapid economic growth. When her father mysteriously disappears while working in Tokyo, Mineko leaves her hometown to find him and support her family. Along the way, she works in factories, forms lasting friendships, and experiences the joys and hardships of city life. Through perseverance and kindness, Mineko matures into a strong, independent woman while discovering the importance of family, community, and hope.

programme.title: Hiyokko
programme.desc: Hiyokko mengisahkan Mineko Yatabe, gadis ceria dari sebuah desa pertanian di Prefektur Ibaraki pada masa pertumbuhan ekonomi Jepang tahun 1960-an. Ketika ayahnya menghilang saat bekerja di Tokyo, Mineko memutuskan merantau ke ibu kota untuk mencarinya sekaligus membantu perekonomian keluarga. Selama perjalanannya, ia bekerja di pabrik, menjalin persahabatan baru, dan menghadapi berbagai tantangan kehidupan di kota besar. Dengan semangat pantang menyerah, Mineko belajar tentang arti keluarga, persahabatan, kerja keras, dan harapan di tengah perubahan zaman.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz delivers comprehensive coverage of the entertainment world through the latest celebrity news, exclusive interviews, behind-the-scenes features, and updates on movies, television, music, and lifestyle. The program also highlights upcoming events, industry trends, and inspiring stories from artists and entertainers, providing viewers with a complete overview of the entertainment scene.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz menghadirkan berbagai informasi terkini seputar industri hiburan, mulai dari kabar selebritas, film, serial televisi, musik, hingga gaya hidup. Program ini juga menyuguhkan liputan di balik layar, wawancara eksklusif dengan para artis, serta ulasan mengenai tren dan peristiwa terbaru di dunia entertainment. Dengan penyajian yang ringan dan informatif, Show Biz menjadi sumber informasi bagi penonton yang ingin mengikuti perkembangan industri hiburan.

programme.title: The Borderless World
programme.desc: The Borderless World is a news magazine program that delivers in-depth reports on international affairs, global trends, and human-interest stories. Covering topics such as politics, business, technology, culture, and social issues, the program highlights how events around the world influence people's lives while presenting unique Taiwanese perspectives on international developments.

programme.title: The Borderless World
programme.desc: The Borderless World menghadirkan laporan mendalam mengenai berbagai peristiwa internasional, mulai dari politik, ekonomi, teknologi, budaya, hingga isu sosial yang berkembang di berbagai belahan dunia. Melalui peliputan langsung, wawancara, dan analisis yang komprehensif, program ini memberikan perspektif yang lebih luas terhadap berbagai isu global sekaligus menyoroti dampaknya terhadap kehidupan masyarakat.

programme.title: Mr. Player
programme.desc: Mr. Player follows Pun, who returns to Thailand after her fiancé disappears with her savings. Determined to find him, she approaches Ploy, a successful actress and the fugitive's sister, hoping to uncover his whereabouts. As their relationship grows more complicated, secrets, deception, and unexpected romance emerge, forcing both women to confront the truth while navigating danger, betrayal, and their evolving feelings for one another.

programme.title: Mr. Player
programme.desc: Mr. Player mengisahkan Pun yang kembali ke Thailand setelah tunangannya melarikan diri membawa seluruh tabungannya. Dalam upaya mencari pelaku, ia mendekati Ploy, seorang aktris ternama yang juga merupakan adik sang buronan. Pencarian tersebut perlahan membuka berbagai rahasia, kebohongan, dan konspirasi yang tidak pernah mereka duga. Di tengah konflik yang semakin rumit, hubungan keduanya berkembang menjadi kisah yang menguji kepercayaan, keberanian, dan arti cinta yang sesungguhnya.

programme.title: Father's Wish
programme.desc: Father's Wish tells the emotional story of a father's unwavering love and sacrifice for his family. As unexpected hardships threaten their future, he remains determined to fulfill an important promise that will secure a better life for his loved ones. Through moments of joy, heartbreak, and resilience, the film explores the enduring bond between parent and child, highlighting the strength of family, hope, and unconditional love.

programme.title: Father's Wish
programme.desc: Father's Wish mengisahkan perjalanan emosional seorang ayah yang rela berkorban demi kebahagiaan keluarganya. Di tengah berbagai cobaan hidup yang datang silih berganti, ia berusaha menepati sebuah janji penting yang diyakininya dapat memberikan harapan dan masa depan yang lebih baik bagi orang-orang yang dicintainya. Kisah ini menghadirkan makna tentang kasih sayang orang tua, pengorbanan, keteguhan hati, dan pentingnya menjaga ikatan keluarga dalam menghadapi berbagai tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: A Culinary Journey
programme.desc: A Culinary Journey takes viewers on a flavorful exploration of diverse culinary traditions across different regions. Each episode highlights local ingredients, time-honored recipes, and the stories of chefs, home cooks, and artisans who preserve their communities' food heritage. Combining travel, history, and gastronomy, the series celebrates how food reflects culture, identity, and everyday life.

programme.title: A Culinary Journey
programme.desc: A Culinary Journey mengajak pemirsa menyusuri berbagai daerah untuk mengenal kekayaan kuliner lokal. Setiap episode menampilkan bahan-bahan khas, resep tradisional, serta kisah para koki, juru masak rumahan, dan pelaku kuliner yang menjaga warisan gastronomi daerahnya. Dipadukan dengan unsur perjalanan dan budaya, program ini memperlihatkan bagaimana makanan menjadi bagian penting dari identitas dan kehidupan masyarakat.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef is one of Taiwan's most popular cooking variety shows, produced by Sanlih E-Television. Hosted by Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo alongside renowned chefs James and Wu Bing-Cheng, the program blends cooking demonstrations with celebrity competitions, themed culinary challenges, and humorous studio interactions. Viewers can learn practical recipes, professional cooking techniques, and kitchen tips while enjoying lighthearted entertainment and appearances by popular Taiwanese celebrities.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour is a travel reality program where celebrity teams design and experience travel itineraries based on different themes and budgets. Throughout each episode, the teams visit popular attractions, discover hidden gems, enjoy local cuisine, and share practical travel tips. At the end of the journey, a panel and audience determine which itinerary offers the most memorable and worthwhile travel experience.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour mengajak para selebritas untuk berkompetisi menyusun rencana perjalanan dengan tema dan anggaran tertentu. Dalam setiap episode, mereka mengunjungi berbagai destinasi wisata, mencicipi kuliner khas, serta memperkenalkan tempat-tempat menarik yang layak dikunjungi. Melalui pengalaman seru, interaksi yang menghibur, dan rekomendasi perjalanan yang praktis, program ini memberikan inspirasi wisata bagi para penonton.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Produced by Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night is a long-running variety program hosted by Jacky Wu alongside Chen Han-Dian and Lulu Huang. Each episode features celebrity guests competing in creative games, themed challenges, comedy segments, musical performances, and entertaining talk sessions. Blending humor, competition, and pop culture, the show has become one of Taiwan's highest-rated entertainment programs and has received multiple Golden Bell Award nominations and wins.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night merupakan salah satu acara variety paling populer di Taiwan. Dipandu oleh Jacky Wu bersama Chen Han-Dian dan Lulu Huang, setiap episode menghadirkan bintang tamu dari dunia hiburan untuk mengikuti berbagai permainan kreatif, tantangan bertema, penampilan musik, hingga segmen komedi yang mengundang tawa. Dengan perpaduan hiburan, kompetisi, dan interaksi spontan antar selebritas, acara ini telah menjadi favorit pemirsa serta meraih berbagai penghargaan bergengsi, termasuk Golden Bell Awards.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating traditions and folklore of Taiwan in The Tradition Story of Taiwan. Each episode delves into ancient legends, local customs, religious beliefs, historical figures, and cultural practices that continue to shape Taiwanese identity today. Combining storytelling with visits to historical sites and local communities, the program offers viewers an engaging journey through Taiwan's diverse cultural heritage and enduring traditions.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

programme.title: Battle Tour

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: MAMAN, NE ME LAISSE PAS M'ENDORMIR
programme.desc: Based on the true story and memoir by Juliette Boudre, the film follows a mother's relentless struggle to save her son Joseph from a severe addiction to prescription medications, including anxiolytics and opioids. As Joseph's condition worsens, Juliette and her family seek every possible solution, from medical treatment to rehabilitation programs. Despite moments of hope and progress, they face immense emotional, social, and medical challenges in a heartbreaking battle against addiction.

programme.title: MAMAN, NE ME LAISSE PAS M'ENDORMIR

Bersama keluarga, Juliette berupaya mencari berbagai cara untuk membantu Joseph pulih, mulai dari konsultasi medis hingga rehabilitasi. Namun perjalanan mereka dipenuhi tantangan, keputusasaan, dan harapan yang silih berganti dalam pertarungan panjang melawan kecanduan yang mengancam nyawa.

programme.title: SOLEIL, UN BUSINESS BIEN DORÉ
programme.desc: The sun is essential to life, but it has also become the driving force behind a vast global industry. Through an in-depth investigation, this documentary explores the lucrative sunscreen market, estimated to be worth more than €9 billion worldwide. From marketing claims and protection ratings to environmental concerns and public health recommendations, the film examines whether consumers are truly receiving the protection they are promised. It also investigates the ecological impact of sunscreen products on marine ecosystems and questions the responsibility of manufacturers in balancing health, profit, and sustainability.

programme.title: SOLEIL, UN BUSINESS BIEN DORÉ
programme.desc: Matahari merupakan sumber kehidupan, tetapi juga menjadi fondasi bagi industri perlindungan matahari yang bernilai lebih dari 9 miliar euro di seluruh dunia. Melalui investigasi mendalam, dokumenter ini menelusuri berbagai aspek bisnis sunscreen, mulai dari klaim pemasaran, tingkat perlindungan yang sebenarnya, hingga dampaknya terhadap kesehatan dan lingkungan. Film ini mempertanyakan apakah produk yang beredar benar-benar memberikan perlindungan sesuai yang dijanjikan, sekaligus menyoroti konsekuensi ekologis dari penggunaan produk tabir surya terhadap lautan dan ekosistemnya. Di tengah meningkatnya suhu global dan kesadaran akan kesehatan kulit, dokumenter ini mengungkap sisi tersembunyi dari sebuah bisnis yang terus berkembang pesat.

programme.title: Undercover Chef: Korea, Ep 10
programme.desc: Chefs Kwon Sung Jun, Jung Ji Sun, and Sam Kim are widely recognized figures in South Korea’s culinary world. Although they are now celebrated chefs, it has been a long time since they last worked as junior cooks in a professional kitchen. To prove that their skills remain as sharp as ever, the three are sent to countries that inspired their cooking styles, where they go undercover as entry-level kitchen staff. The challenge does not end there: they have only five days to impress their superiors and create a signature dish worthy of being added to the restaurant’s menu. Will their experience and expertise be enough to achieve success, or will they crumble under the pressure?

programme.title: Undercover Chef: Korea, Ep 10
programme.desc: Koki Kwon Sung Jun, Jung Ji Sun, dan Sam Kim telah dikenal luas di dunia kuliner Korea Selatan. Meski kini berstatus sebagai koki ternama, sudah lama sejak mereka terakhir bekerja sebagai juru masak junior di dapur. Untuk membuktikan bahwa kemampuan mereka masih tajam, ketiganya dikirim ke negara-negara yang menginspirasi masakan mereka dan menyamar sebagai staf dapur tingkat bawah. Tantangannya tidak berhenti di situ: mereka hanya memiliki lima hari untuk mengesankan atasan mereka dan membuat hidangan khas yang berhasil masuk ke menu restoran. Akankah pengalaman dan keterampilan mereka cukup untuk meraih kesuksesan atau justru mereka akan tumbang di bawah tekanan?

programme.title: The Tiger
programme.desc: While the Kingdom of Korea is under occupation by the Japanese, an old and experienced hunter is challenged by the hunt of the last tiger.

programme.title: The Tiger
programme.desc: Saat Kerajaan Korea berada di bawah pendudukan Jepang, seorang pemburu tua dan berpengalaman ditantang oleh perburuan harimau terakhir.

programme.title: You Will Die In 6 Hours
programme.desc: Jun Woo alerts Jeong Yun about her upcoming murder. Skeptical, she investigates, uncovering Jun Woo's link to serial killings. She races to learn if he's protecting or deceiving her before her prophesized death.

programme.title: You Will Die In 6 Hours
programme.desc: Jun Woo memperingatkan Jeong Yun tentang pembunuhan yang akan menimpanya. Dengan rasa skeptis, ia mulai menyelidiki dan menemukan keterkaitan Jun Woo dengan serangkaian pembunuhan. Ia pun berpacu dengan waktu untuk mengetahui apakah Jun Woo melindunginya atau justru menipunya sebelum kematian yang telah diramalkan itu terjadi.

programme.title: 6/45: Lucky Lotto
programme.desc: The excitement of winning a lottery ticket doesn't last long for sergeant Chun-woo as it accidentally ends up crossing the Military Demarcation Line. He must get his act together and find it again!

programme.title: 6/45: Lucky Lotto
programme.desc: Kegembiraan karena menang lotre tak berlangsung lama bagi sersan Chun-woo sebab secara tak sengaja tiket lotre tersebut melintasi Garis Demarkasi Militer. Ia harus mengendalikan dirinya dan menemukan jalan keluar!

programme.title: Hello Ghost
programme.desc: A man's failed suicide attempt enables him to see ghosts, who later keep following him everywhere. It is now up to him to fulfill their wishes to make them go away.

programme.title: Emergency Declaration
programme.desc: Mysterious deaths on plane forced the pilot to call for an unconditional emergency landing.

programme.title: Emergency Declaration
programme.desc: Sejumlah kematian misterius yang terjadi di dalam pesawat memaksa sang pilot untuk meminta izin pendaratan darurat tanpa syarat.

programme.title: Double Patty
programme.desc: An aspiring news anchor and a struggling wrestler meets by chance at a burger joint. Through shared meals, they encourage each other to reach for their dreams!

programme.title: Double Patty
programme.desc: Seorang pembawa berita berbakat dan seorang pegulat yang tengah berjuang bertemu secara tidak sengaja di sebuah kedai burger. Saat makan bersama, mereka saling menyemangati satu sama lain untuk meraih impian mereka!

programme.title: The Hot-Blooded
programme.desc: 4 friends gave up on Taekwondo and part ways after being asked to lose on purpose in a trial. Years later, they decided to take on a local gang realizing their hometown is threatened.

programme.title: The Hot-Blooded
programme.desc: Empat sekawan berhenti Taekwondo dan berpisah usai diminta untuk kalah dengan sengaja dalam sebuah uji coba. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, mereka memutuskan untuk menghadapi geng lokal saat kampung halaman mereka terancam.

programme.title: The Snitch (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: In drug crime circles, 'Ya-Dang' informants sell criminals' info. Criminals use this to reduce sentences, while law enforcement uses it for arrests. Ya-Dang, police and prosecutors form a key triangle.

programme.title: The Snitch (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Dalam lingkaran kejahatan narkoba, informan 'Ya-Dang' menjual informasi kriminal. Penjahat menggunakannya untuk mengurangi hukuman, sementara penegak hukum menggunakannya untuk penangkapan. Ya-Dang, polisi, dan jaksa membentuk segitiga kunci.

programme.title: Ordinary Person (TVN Movies)
programme.desc: An up-righteous police officer with a wife and son gets involved with a conspiracy after he arrested a murderer by chance. His weakness was his son needed an operation to treat his legs. Which path to choose? Righteousness or conspiracy?

programme.title: Ordinary Person (TVN Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang polisi yang jujur dan berintegritas, yang memiliki istri dan anak, terlibat dalam sebuah konspirasi setelah secara kebetulan menangkap seorang pembunuh. Kelemahannya adalah anaknya membutuhkan operasi untuk mengobati kakinya. Jalan mana yang harus dipilih? Keadilan atau konspirasi?

programme.title: The Glorious My Revenge
programme.desc: Three years after the expiration of the ten year statute of limitations, police detective Ryoo Yi-jae meets the man who killed his son in a hit and run accident.

programme.title: The Glorious My Revenge
programme.desc: Tiga tahun setelah berakhirnya undang-undang pembatasan sepuluh tahun, detektif polisi Ryoo Yi-jae bertemu dengan pria yang membunuh putranya dalam kecelakaan tabrak lari.

programme.title: Cafe Midnight
programme.desc: Yoon went searching for her groom Taeyoung who didn't show up on the wedding day. She arrives at a strange place called 'Cafe Midnight' by chance and found a younger Taeyoung from the past.

programme.title: Cafe Midnight
programme.desc: Yoon pergi mencari pengantin prianya, Taeyoung, yang tidak muncul di hari pernikahan. Secara kebetulan, ia tiba di sebuah tempat aneh bernama 'Cafe Midnight' dan menemukan Taeyoung yang berusia muda dari masa lalu.

programme.title: Only God Knows Everything
programme.desc: After his ordination, Father Do-woon hears a confession revealing his mother’s 13-year disappearance. Bound by sacred secrecy and revenge, he sets out to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Only God Knows Everything
programme.desc: Usai ditahbiskan, Pastor Do-woon mendengar pengakuan yang menguak hilangnya sang ibu 13 tahun lalu. Terbelenggu rahasia suci dan dendam, ia memilih memburu kebenaran.

programme.title: Firefighters
programme.desc: After drastic tragedies and changes, firefighters must see themselves helping out the entire world each day, even though in personal life and in work, going against all odds.

programme.title: Hijack 1971
programme.desc: The movie depics the story of people fighting for their lives in an extreme situation when a passenger plane is hijacked in the airspace of Korea in 1971.
